scale.interpretation: The vertical position orders selected evidence checkpoints. It is not a completion percentage, quality score, or test pass rate.

points.title: Standalone import
points.summary: Galileo begins its standalone repository history while preserving the inherited Servo lineage and licences.

points.title: Turnstile canary
points.summary: The official dummy-key canary retained 3/3 controlled modes headless and 3/3 headed.

points.title: Fixed WPT shard
points.summary: The retained Galileo run passed all 286 named subtests in the fixed three-file shard.

points.title: YouTube qualification
points.summary: A clean-profile real-site journey completed HD playback and 5/5 seeks; later replay evidence also exposed one 4.056-second stall.

points.title: Feature inventory
points.summary: The reviewed catalogue recorded observed partial behaviour in 54 of 68 tracked product areas.

points.title: WebCodecs expanded
points.summary: Raw VideoFrame, copy and structured transfer, and encoded chunk contracts became implemented and testable code paths.

points.title: Extension runtime checkpoint
points.summary: The reviewed head includes modular extension runtime work, receiver-liveness checks, responsiveness changes, and bounded network decisions.

boundary: This is a selected chronology of major evidence-backed Galileo checkpoints through the reviewed source head. It does not count every commit, and it does not turn implementation activity into release readiness. Older measured results retain their original dates.
